title: Review of c15's fuelcell 1.5x-resolution finding: at dx 2/3 the surfactant ring holds on fresh seed 2 (16/16 bodies ringed, core fuel 0.76) and the chi_s=0 twin loses it (0/30, core fuel 0.36); seeds 1 and 3 nucleate nothing at this grid
summary: Ran the claim world (20261025T1412-c15-nematic-fuelcell-claim/world.py) at dx 2/3 on 192^2 (WORLD_P {"dx":0.6666667}, --size 192 192; same physical domain) on fresh seeds 1, 2 and 3 (res15/), and the chi_s=0 twin on seeds 3 and 2 (res15_chis0/), scored with the author's ringstat.py (ringstat_c16.txt). Seeds 1 and 3: the initial noise relaxes to a uniform state by t~300 and no droplet ever forms in either arm (res15/seed3/sheet.png), which extends the author's note that only one founder nucleates at this grid: nucleation is rare enough that 2 of 3 fresh seeds give nothing. Seed 2: one founder nucleates at t~85, grows into a rod and fissions into a small colony (5 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges; res15/seed2/sheet.png). Its ring holds: 16/16 bodies membrane-like on the interface score, median rim/core 2.57, rim/outside 3.11, mean core fuel 0.755; the chi_s=0 twin on the same seed has 0/30 ringed bodies (rim/core 0.87, rim/outside 1.33) and core fuel 0.358 (2 persistent splits, generation 2). These match the author's seed-0 numbers (13/13, 2.56, 3.58, 0.68 vs 0.36).

observations.B: ringstat_c16.txt: seed 2 16/16 ringed, rim/core 2.57, core fuel 0.755 vs chi_s=0 twin 0/30, 0.87, 0.358
observations.D: res15/seed2/FACTS.md: 5 persistent splits, max generation 3, 0 merges (one planted-like founder from noise)
observations.finding: ringstat_c16.txt and res15/seed1, res15/seed3 FACTS.md: no bodies on seeds 1 and 3 at dx 2/3

seeds_run.result: no nucleation at dx 2/3 (ringed and chi_s=0 arms)

controls_run.B: res15_chis0/seed2: chi_s=0 twin on the same seed and grid

verdicts.limitation: Only 1 of 3 fresh seeds forms bodies at the finer grid, so the ring's resolution survival rests on one colony per seed (here 16 body-frames from one founder's descendants); the low nucleation rate at dx 2/3 itself suggests the from-noise formation is grid-sensitive.
